text: The physical exam findings of epicanthus, upward slanting eyes, low-set ears, and a single transverse palmar crease are classic signs of Trisomy 21 (Down syndrome), which is strongly associated with duodenal atresia causing bilious vomiting. The abdominal X-ray would likely show the "double bubble" sign confirming this obstruction. DIAGNOSIS READY: Duodenal Atresia
